content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Patna Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 04-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Patna (IIT Patna) for a DRDO-sponsored research project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by IIT Patna?
faq.answer: IIT Patna has advertised openings for the Junior Research Fellow position under advertisement number R&D/1086/DLD/628.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Junior Research Fellow post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for IIT Patna JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed application form via email is 04-10-2026. Applicants must submit before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BE, BTech, MSc, ME, MTech, or equivalent degree in EE, ECE, Instrumentation, Physics, or CSE, IT related disciplines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for IIT Patna JRF jobs?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly through email. Candidates need to send their documents directly to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary provided for Junior Research Fellows?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive Rs. 37,000/- per month for the 1st year and Rs. 42,000/- per month for the 2nd year.

faq.question: Q8. When is the online interview scheduled for shortlisted candidates?
faq.answer: The date of the online interview for the shortlisted candidates has been scheduled for 05-10-2026.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification for submitting the job application.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website to check further details?
faq.answer: You can check further updates and details regarding the institution by visiting the official website at www.iitp.ac.in.
